title: Čech complex and cohomology commute with the first finite covering limit
statement:
Let $X$ be affine, $\Lambda$ a finite discrete ring, $F$ an étale sheaf of left $\Lambda$-modules, and $M=\nu_X^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $\mathcal V=\{V_a\to U\}_{a=1}^m$ be a nonempty finite basis covering and choose the first-limit systems $\mathcal V_j$ and $T_{\alpha,j}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-intersection-limit-compatibility]. The canonical restriction maps give an isomorphism of cochain complexes of abelian groups
$$\varinjlim_j\check C^\bullet(\mathcal V_j,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\check C^\bullet(\mathcal V,M),$$
and induce isomorphisms $\varinjlim_j\check H^q(\mathcal V_j,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\check H^q(\mathcal V,M)$ for every $q\ge0$. The complexes are the ordered alternating Čech complexes of [def-weil-pbc-cover-cech], including repeated indices. No injectivity of $F$ is assumed.
